title: Orange Infused Turkish Tofu Doner Kebab
description: A citrusy, one‑pot Turkish-style tofu doner that blends orange juice, fresh tomatoes and fragrant spices for a flavorful, macrobiotic-friendly meal.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: pressed and sliced into thin strips

instructions: Press the tofu for at least 30 minutes to remove excess moisture, then cut into thin strips.
Whisk together orange juice, tomato paste, cumin, paprika, coriander, salt, pepper, and olive oil until smooth.
Add the tofu strips to the bowl, stir to coat, and whisk in orange zest; let marinate at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Pour the diced tomatoes into the same bowl and mix gently to combine all ingredients.
Heat a large non‑stick skillet over medium heat and pour the tofu‑tomato mixture, spreading evenly.
Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and the tofu turns slightly golden.
Remove from heat and transfer the mixture onto a plate.
Sprinkle chopped parsley over the top before serving.
Serve the orange infused Turkish tofu doner kebab over cooked bulgur or cauliflower rice for a macrobiotic option.
